review.reviewer: GitHub Copilot using Security Review Framework v2
review.scope: Sample report data for dashboard validation

topRisks: Object-level authorization gap on invoice access
Sensitive data may be written to application logs
Cloud storage encryption policy should be verified

findings.title: Object-level authorization missing on invoice download
findings.description: The invoice download handler uses a request-controlled invoice ID without checking that the invoice belongs to the authenticated user or tenant.
evidence: No tenant or owner check is visible before returning the PDF.

transformations: String parameter passed to repository lookup
sourceToSink.impact: Authenticated user can access another user's invoice by guessing or obtaining an ID

findings.exploitability: An authenticated user can change the invoice ID in the URL and request invoices owned by other users if IDs are known or guessable.
findings.attackScenario: A user downloads their invoice, changes the URL parameter to another invoice ID, and receives another customer's billing document.
findings.impact: Unauthorized disclosure of billing data and potential cross-tenant data exposure.
findings.remediation: Fetch invoices by both ID and authorized tenant/user, or enforce an authorization policy before returning the file.

findings.title: Request logger may capture authorization headers
findings.owasp: A09:2021 Security Logging and Monitoring Failures
findings.description: The logger serializes request headers. It is unclear whether authorization headers are redacted before log export.
evidence: Request headers are included in structured log context.
findings.exploitability: If authorization headers are exported to centralized logs, users with log access may retrieve bearer tokens.
findings.attackScenario: An operator or compromised log account searches for authorization headers and reuses active bearer tokens.
findings.impact: Credential exposure and session hijacking risk.
findings.remediation: Redact `Authorization`, cookies, API keys, and tokens before logging request metadata.

sprint: Verify and fix SRF-002 log redaction.
hardening: Document log data classification and retention.
